layout.footer: You're getting this email because this address is linked to your Disscount account. You can change your email settings any time after <link>signing in to Disscount</link>.
layout.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser: <link>{url}</link>

verification.subject: Confirm your email address
verification.preview: One more click and your Disscount account is ready.
verification.heading: We're glad you're here!
verification.intro: Confirm your email address and your Disscount account is ready. After that, you can save shopping lists and add your favorite products to your watchlist.
verification.footnote: If you didn't create this account, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: The link to set a new password expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
passwordReset.heading: Forgot your password? No problem.
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for your Disscount account. Use the button below to set a new one. This link expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
passwordReset.footnote: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

setPassword.subject: Set a password for your Disscount account
setPassword.preview: Add a password to sign in with email too.
setPassword.heading: Add a password to your account
setPassword.intro: You already have a Disscount account for this email address, linked to Google or Facebook. Once you add a password, you can sign in with email too. This link expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
setPassword.footnote: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your account stays the same.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email address
changeEmail.preview: One quick step: confirm your new email address.
changeEmail.heading: Changing your email address?
changeEmail.intro: Someone asked to change the email address on your Disscount account to <email>{newEmail}</email>. The change only takes effect once you confirm it.
changeEmail.footnote: If you didn't ask for this, change your password right away and get in touch. Your address stays the same until you confirm the change.

breachedPassword.subject: Your password turned up in a data breach
breachedPassword.preview: We found your password in a data breach, set a new one.
breachedPassword.heading: Your password turned up in a data breach
breachedPassword.intro: Someone just tried to sign in to your Disscount account with the correct password. We found that password in a known data breach from another site, so we didn't let the sign-in through. Set a new password with the button below. Once you do, we'll sign you out on every device. The link works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
breachedPassword.footnote: If this wasn't you, set a new password anyway. If you use this password anywhere else, change it there too.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Disscount account
accountExists.preview: Someone tried to sign up with your email address.
accountExists.heading: You already have an account with this address
accountExists.intro: Someone just tried to sign up for Disscount with this email address, and an account for it already exists. If that was you, just sign in. Can't remember your password? Choose "Forgot password" in the sign-in window.
accountExists.footnote: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Your account stays the same.

completeSignUp.subject: Finish signing up for Disscount
completeSignUp.preview: Set a password to finish signing up. The link expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
completeSignUp.heading: Finish signing up
completeSignUp.intro: Someone just tried to sign up for Disscount with this email address. An account for it already exists, but the address isn't confirmed yet. If the account is yours, set a password with the button below to confirm the address. This link expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
completeSignUp.footnote: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Until the address is confirmed, nobody can sign in to this account with a password.
